info.description:
Complete GateSphere backend API — every route, generated from the live FastAPI app by `docs/postman/build_collection.py`.

**Multi-role sessions:** each request logs in as its own role via `ensureSession(role)` (collection pre-request script) and sends `X-Session-Role`. Sessions live in Postman's cookie jar — no `{{token}}` variable. Do NOT collapse the roles into one session.

Run order: `00 Health` -> `01 Authentication` -> `_Workflow` (creates + saves ids) -> the module folders -> `_Negative`.
